Hymn 133: Father in Heaven
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Janice Kapp Perry
Lyricist/Text Author: Janice Kapp Perry
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 133 titled "Father in Heaven" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Janice Kapp Perry and the lyrics were written by Janice Kapp Perry.
